_comment: The shared plate gate: which plate reads count as a car's identity. Used by dvsa-label (which plates get looked up and label tracks), vehicles and the showcase (plate identity) and the stats page's fastest-car plates. Copy to configs/alpr.json. Two modes (plate_gate): 'conf' (the default without the file) counts a read whose ocr_conf -- the probability of its least certain character -- is at least plate_conf_threshold; 'combined' (review E1.4, 2026-10-04) counts a read whose ocr_conf is at least supported_conf_threshold AND that is corroborated: another snap of the same track read the same string, or at least min_support tracks anywhere have it as their best read. Plate colour is applied upstream (alpr-run / alpr-colour drop reads whose plate colour contradicts the track's direction). A one-off --conf-threshold (dvsa-label) or --conf (vehicles) forces the plain conf gate. Thresholds must be in (0, 1]; keys starting with _ are comments, any other key is rejected. After changing it, run the panel's plate-check (or relabel) playbook.
